answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) excel at synthesizing information and identifying patterns, and thus hold promise for transforming hypothesis generation. ... we introduce a literature-based hypothesis agent. This agent interacts with the data-driven hypothesis agent (HYPOGENIC), refining and maintaining a shared pool of hypotheses ...
answer_1.outputs: textual hypotheses describing patterns for classification tasks

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation results show that integrating literature and data outperforms other baselines: ... accuracy on out-of-distribution datasets, a measure of generalizability. ... We compute the average accuracy for all data instances in the held-out IND and OOD sets with the model predictions.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 60 Prolific participants and randomly assign them into experimental and control groups... We also recruit 30 participants with graduate level degrees in social sciences... Participants rate hypotheses on clarity, novelty, and plausibility using 5-point Likert scales.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rate generated hypotheses on scales such as 'Not at all helpful' to 'Extremely helpful' and on clarity, novelty, and plausibility using 5-point Likert scales.
